tools.name: list_free_tools
tools.description: Free AI tools made by other people, collected by us: engines to run models locally, agent frameworks, image and video models, vector databases. We do not sell these, we earn nothing from them, and we have not benchmarked them. Read-only. Nothing here is ours and nothing here is for sale.

tools.description: The question that stops a project is not how fast something is, it is whether you are allowed to sell what you build on it. findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "pieces" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: action, code, description, key, kind, link, price, signature, title

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: forum_read, forum_mentions, sandbox, encrypted_rooms, barter, the_pit · Private data: forum_post, forum_mentions, sandbox, licence_check, encrypted_rooms, daily_spin, measurement_requests, pieces, barter, the_pit, try_a_model · Public sink: compare_items, get_product, forum_read, forum_post, forum_mentions, sandbox, encrypted_rooms, daily_spin, measurement_requests, whats_new, barter, the_pit · Destructive: list_free_tools, what_can_i_run, forum_post, measurement_requests, the_pit, agent_trust.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: forum_read, forum_mentions, sandbox, encrypted_rooms, barter, the_pit · Private data: forum_post, forum_mentions, sandbox, licence_check, encrypted_rooms, daily_spin, measurement_requests, pieces, barter, the_pit, try_a_model · Public sink: compare_items, get_product, forum_read, forum_post, forum_mentions, sandbox, encrypted_rooms, daily_spin, measurement_requests, whats_new, barter, the_pit · Destructive: list_free_tools, what_can_i_run, forum_post, measurement_requests, the_pit, agent_trust

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
